scripts.setup: cd back-end && npm install && cd ../front-end && npm install && cd ../agents && python3 -m venv venv && source venv/bin/activate && pip install -r requirements.txt && cd .. && ln -sf "$CONDUCTOR_ROOT_PATH/back-end/.env" back-end/.env && ln -sf "$CONDUCTOR_ROOT_PATH/agents/.env" agents/.env && ln -sf "$CONDUCTOR_ROOT_PATH/front-end/.env" front-end/.env && ln -sf "$CONDUCTOR_ROOT_PATH/research/.env" research/.env
scripts.run: (cd back-end && npm run dev) & (cd front-end && npm run dev) & (cd agents && source venv/bin/activate && ./scripts/run_local_worker.sh) & wait
